properties.source: Channel centreline drawn by hand through the narrows between Larak Island (Iran) and the Quoin islands off Ras Musandam (Oman), following the Omani-waters traffic separation scheme described in Wikipedia 'Strait of Hormuz' (strait centre 26.6N 56.5E, ~39 km narrows). Checked to lie entirely in water on Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain) land. Approximate at strait-frame scale.
refs: Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain), commit f1890d9
